epics.title: System Containerization and Launch
epics.jtbd: When operating the platform, I want a single command to start the entire system locally, so that I can verify it works end-to-end without manual configuration.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce system startup failure rate from 100% to 0% and time-to-first-healthy-launch below 2 minutes.
epics.tocConstraintRef: Deployment overhead bottleneck - engineering and QA verification cycle time.
requirements: R1: The repository must contain a valid docker-compose.yml at the root.
R2: The docker-compose configuration must start the complete backend and frontend stack and expose a health-check endpoint to confirm successful launch.

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack launch
slices.jtbd: When implementing container orchestration for this epic, I want to define the services, networks, and volumes in docker-compose, so that the entire platform starts with one command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean clone of the repository
When a developer runs `docker-compose up -d`
Then all services start correctly and report healthy via a health-check endpoint.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% success rate on `docker-compose up` execution on a clean machine.

epics.title: Launch Health Fix
epics.jtbd: When launching the platform, I want the system to start cleanly without errors, so that I can observe and verify its actual runtime behavior.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Improve successful health-check rate on launch from 0% to 100%.
requirements: R1: Resolve the error 'docker-compose.yml not found at repo root after clone' by ensuring the configuration exists and functions correctly.

slices.title: Resolve docker-compose.yml not found error
slices.jtbd: When implementing the launch fix for this epic, I want to commit the missing docker-compose.yml to the repository root, so that the launcher can find and start it.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the launch script checks the repository root
When it looks for `docker-compose.yml`
Then the file is found and the orchestration tool proceeds without error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero occurrences of 'docker-compose.yml not found' during launch phase.
